documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Management stated that Q2 performance was satisfying with robust demand driven by healthy same-store sales growth across key markets. Consolidated revenue for the quarter was INR10,323 crores, while consolidated profit after tax reached INR427 crores. The company launched its regional brand ATM in T. Nagar, Chennai during August, with plans to open four more showrooms during the current financial year. Management expressed strong confidence in meeting and beating targeted revenue growth, noting an excellent start to the ongoing quarter during Navratri and Dhanteras.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue growth for the year should be a minimum of 25%.
guidance.quote: And with the store number which is increasing and the stores which we have opened in the last financial year, the revenue growth should be a minimum of 25%, which we have always said that.

guidance.claim: The company aims to maintain the share of recycled gold in the range of 55% to 60% going forward.
guidance.quote: For the month of June, the share of recycled gold was in excess of 55%, and our efforts will be to maintain the share in the range of 55% to 60% going forward.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain the PBT margins of the previous year on even a conservative basis for the full year.
guidance.quote: So to answer your question, for the full year, I don't think there will be an impact. Even on a conservative basis, I think we'll be able to maintain the PBT margins of the previous year.

guidance.claim: Management confirmed no change in target regarding opening 84 Kalyan showrooms in India and 50 stores for Candere.
guidance.quote: Yes. No change in target. So last year also has been like this only. So no change in target.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that demand remained robust during most parts of the recently concluded quarter due to healthy same-store sales growth in key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained robust during most part of the recently concluded quarter on the back of very healthy same-store sales growth across most of the key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that the ongoing quarter started very well with strong growth witnessed during Navratri and Dhanteras.
demand_outlook.quote: And now talking about the ongoing quarter. The quarter has started off very well, and we are very encouraged by the growth being witnessed on the ground, especially during Navratri and Dhanteras.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that for the first 40 days of the current quarter, performance has been excellent and volume growth has been observed.
demand_outlook.quote: And as we speak, for the first 40 days it has been excellent and we have seen volume growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remained robust during most of the concluded quarter, except for one month of Adhik-Maas.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained robust during most part of the recently concluded quarter, except for 1 month of. Adhik-Maas.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that demand on the ground is strong and continues like Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes. The demand on ground is strong. It continues like Q1.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the ongoing quarter has started off very well despite volatility in gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: And now talking about the ongoing quarter. The quarter has started off very well despite the volatility in gold prices.

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced plans to launch the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year, with 2 in the ongoing quarter and 2 in the fourth quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: We have drawn up plans for the launch of the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year, 2 will be in the ongoing quarter and 2 more during the fourth quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated there are no immediate plans to launch ATM in a new state and will continue only in Tamil Nadu for a couple of years.
capex_expansion.quote: Now coming to the cash flow utilization, no more immediate plans to launch ATM in a new state. We will continue only in Tamil Nadu because it has to shape up in one state, and which will at least take a couple of years.

capex_expansion.claim: The first showroom of regional brand ATM will be launched on 21st August in Chennai, followed by another four showrooms in the coming months.
capex_expansion.quote: The first showroom will be launched on 21st August in Chennai and shall be followed by another four showrooms in the next coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened 12 FOCO stores in the current quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Because I see in the current quarter, it has been you have opened 12 FOCO stores, right?

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that when removing the one-time benefit of customs duty and silver and platinum gains from the previous year, Q2 margins are stable.
margins_costs.quote: So PBT margins, if you look at in Q2, it is very stable, wherein if you negate the -- of course, the onetime benefit of the customs duty and if you also negate the silver and platinum gains, which was there in the previous year quarter, Q2, you negate both that, the margins are stable.

margins_costs.claim: Management indicated confidence in achieving higher PBT margins in H2 compared to H1.
margins_costs.quote: And H2 you know that PBT margins are usually higher than H1. So we believe that H2 will be of a better PBT margin than H1 and it will be stable.

margins_costs.claim: The share of recycled gold as a percentage of revenue increased to over 46% during Q1 FY 2027.
margins_costs.quote: The initiative was well received by our customers, helping us to increase the share of recycled gold as a percentage of revenue to over 46% during Q1 FY 2027.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that gold exchange is margin dilutive by around 0.2% to 0.3%.
margins_costs.quote: And you know that exchange itself is margin dilutive by around 0.2% -0.3%. That also has to be taken care.

capital_allocation.claim: Management confirmed that the non-GML debt has been fully repaid.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, it is debt-free non-GML now, as you mentioned, and 50% of the collateral is already out of which we have sold one land parcel of INR86 crores, INR87 crores, and INR16 crores to be done on the ongoing quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Management plans to use cash flows to strengthen existing showrooms and inventory to drive same-store sales growth.
capital_allocation.quote: But yes, the cash flow, predominantly, we want to utilize to strengthen our existing showrooms where certain showrooms need more inventory to drive more SSGs.

capital_allocation.claim: Agreements have been signed for 2 separate parcels of non-core real estate assets with an aggregate consideration of around INR 102 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We have signed the agreement with potential buyers for 2 separate parcels of land with an aggregate consideration amount to around INR102 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is on track to complete the non-GML debt repayment by the end of September.
capital_allocation.quote: Regarding the non-GML debt reduction, we are well on track to complete the repayment by end of September.

risks_headwinds.claim: A sharp rise in international oil prices and pressure on forex led to the launch of the Shine with India gold recirculation campaign.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sharp rise in international oil prices and the resultant pressure on forex led us to launch our "Shine with India" gold recirculation campaign.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch four new showrooms during the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have drawn up plans for the launch of the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year, 2 will be in the ongoing quarter and 2 more during the fourth quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to conclude the sale process of non-core real estate assets and receive consideration before the end of the ongoing quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to conclude the sale process and receive consideration before the end of the ongoing quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company is well on track to complete the non-GML debt repayment by the end of September.
management_commitments.quote: Regarding the non-GML debt reduction, we are well on track to complete the repayment by end of September.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
